bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_coll_lane_e #(.GFMT(1), .EPPIPE(2), .LCR(1), .CH_BOARD(700), .RXSRAM(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/link/ot_link_crc32.sv rtl/common/ot_link_credit.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/dsfd_coll_split.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/ot_s81ph_skid2.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/ot_s81ph_ckbuf.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_mem1r1w.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_rfifo.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_link_ep.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_link_gbx.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/coll/ot_s81ph_coll_lane.sv rtl/common/ot_link_credit_rx_sram.sv rtl/lib/ot_sram_showahead_1r1w.sv && echo lint-ok
